caption:
Three places hold your appointments right now.

A text thread. A phone call. A website form. Each one books a slot, and none of them check the other two.

That's how two customers show up for the same 2:00, and how your 10:00 opening sits empty all week.

The Black Arrow platform runs one calendar behind every channel. A text reply, a missed-call callback, a quiz funnel completion, all of it books into the same open slots in real time, then feeds straight into your CRM.

14 days free, full access, no card required. Refer a business and you both get a free month when they subscribe, no manual tracking needed.

rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience offer content, and this fills the under-served Platform/Trial slot with an unclaimed pain (bookings scattered across text, call, and form causing double-bookings) using the platform's verified unified booking-to-CRM feature.
